title: StockSmart Pricing Desk Schedule — Annual Contract Value Share on a Converted Bin's Reorder Point
content:
**Schedule of value shares — StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program, customer-owned reorder point of a bin converted from consignment at a par review.**

**Rule.** The converted item's annual value, its consumption billed over the last twelve months times the contract unit price on its latest price line in the customer's agreement (zero where it has none, or where two price lines share its latest effective date), sets the value share: 30000.00 USD or more puts 0.8, 10000.00 USD or more but below 30000.00 USD puts 0.9, and less leaves the value share as it is.

**Records.** The item's price lines in the customer's Contract Pricing Agreement; the latest is the one with the latest effective date. The consumption is the program's consumption billing of the item in the last twelve months (rows of age below twelve, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month).

| Annual value, USD | Value share |
|---|---|
| 30000.00 or more | 0.8 |
| 10000.00 or more, below 30000.00 | 0.9 |
| below 10000.00 | unchanged |
| no price line, or two lines on the latest effective date | annual value zero: unchanged |

**Hypothetical items.** 1200 units at 25.00: 30000.00, on the line, 0.8. 400 units at 25.00: 10000.00, 0.9. 399 units at 25.00: 9975.00, unchanged.
